decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.
Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.
Condition : 7 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.
Condition : 8 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: The display of an internally illuminated fascia sign and an internally illuminated projecting sign to premises
